subject: Medford Square Main Street Intersection Redesign
overview: The committee met to discuss Resolution 24-422 regarding MassDOT plans for the Main Street and Route 16 intersections in Medford Square. The meeting served as a forum for the Medford Bicycle Commission to address safety and efficiency concerns as the project enters the 25% design phase.

items.title: Resolution 24-422 - MassDOT Medford Square Intersection Plans
items.summary: The committee reviewed proposed MassDOT redesigns for the Main Street and Route 16 intersection corridor to address cyclist and pedestrian safety concerns. Traffic and Transportation Director Todd Blake confirmed that the project is in the early design phase and that a follow-up meeting is scheduled with the Medford Bicycle Commission to refine plans for multi-use paths and signal timing.
